title: 040 NNMT parity and head study -- model stage: the NNMT baseline on the 15-fold harness, the framework-port identity proof, ARO's operating point, and four model variants (raw8; plain multi-task LSTM on the 24 indicators, raw8, and both)
label: PROVISIONAL -- one era (2023-26); halves are the persistence test (constitution gate 2). Nothing is adopted by this stage; it proves the port inert and selects the model (R7) the later stages use.
baseline_report: mt pooled per half beside wf_aro_g24, cs_aro, w_aro and st_g24_rev (judge_one(mt, comparator), reported only -- no verdict on the baseline)

identity.rule: trades_hash equal on 15/15 folds (mt recorded BEFORE the framework port lands, mt_fw0 after; same weights by model key). If it fails, no later verdict of this stage is read until the port is fixed.

mt.role: baseline: NNMT at its defaults (guards on, threshold 0.5, grace 3 h), before the port

mt_fw0.role: identity arm: the same class after the port (EntryFrameworkMixin, everything off)

mt_op.change: ARO's operating point: NNNC_A_Raw_Open.json buy params (guards open, prediction_threshold 0.80); exits stay NNMT's

mt_raw.change: inputs = raw8 (causal-normalised, NNPredict/_inputs.py) in the current network

mt_lr.change: classifier LSTM_RAW (multi-task plain LSTM, no resize/conv, linear heads) on the 24 indicators (ARO's design)

instrument: per arm: a record for all 15 folds, model trained per fold on its training window (run_folds strict artefact check), and trades in both halves; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (no P&L read)
model_share: per arm, from the signal tables: 1 - entries / guard-passing bars (research R4). Reported for every arm. A variant whose share is below min_model_share is INCONCLUSIVE (the guards, not the model, would decide its entries); mt_op is always judged.

selection.R7: the candidate with the highest pooled total pp over f00-f14 among those whose judge_one halves vs mt_op have no WORSENED verdict and whose instrument passed (mt_op itself qualifies); ties -> mt_op.

seeds: the selected model and mt_op are re-run on seed 2 (research R13); the seed-2 result is reported beside seed 1. Any later PASS (or delta < 1 pp) needs seed 2.
seen_before: NNMT single-window studies W1-W3 (memory: guards pick ~93% of entries; model headroom +0.02 pp; task weights unresolvable; apply_task_filters -14 pp)
no 15-fold harness result for any NNMT class
NNNC ARO (wf_aro_g24), cs_aro, w_aro, st_g24_rev records (comparators, existing)
